verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows an official AI assistant built into three.js or its editor that generates scripts, answers API questions, or scaffolds scenes. The llms.txt and llms-full.txt files are machine-readable docs that external LLMs can consume. That is an adjacent building block, not an in-engine assistant, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an official AI assistant inside the engine helps with engine tasks — generating scripts, answering API questions, scaffolding scenes or assets
